newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore share market closed Wednesday/Thursday.
newsitem.headline: Singapore share market closed Wednesday/Thursday.

text.p: The Singapore share market was closed Wednesday for the New Year holiday and will be closed Thursday for Singapore general elections.
On Tuesday Singapore shares ended mostly unchanged to firmer on scattered year-end buying, dealers said.
The key Straits Times Industrials Index ended 1.66 points down on Tuesday at 2,216.79 while the SES All-share index was up 3.48 points at 536.12.
Turnover was light around 47 million shares, with gainers leading losers by 171 to 117.
The market traded only in the first half session ahead of the New Year holiday.
Hongkong Land Holdings, which led the actives with 3.1 million shares, saw 809,000 shares crossed between US$2.76 and US$2.81. The share ended down 10 cents at US$2.78.

Cam International saw 2.5 million of its 2.7 million shares crossed at S$0.80. The precision engineering firm ended down a cent at S$0.63. Creative Technology rose S$0.50 to S$14.60 while UOB foreign and Keppel fell S$0.30 and S$0.20 to S$15.60 and S$10.90 respectively. -- Angela Tan (65 8703083)
